reviews.review_description:
HoverLap offers a refreshing approach to VR racing by completely removing thumbstick steering. Leaning into corners while physically pulling back to brake and pushing forward to boost makes driving intuitive, active and genuinely designed for VR.
Chasing Bronze, Silver and Gold times quickly creates that addictive “one more lap” feeling, while unlockable vehicles and global leaderboards encourage you to improve. A fun and original arcade racer with a control system that gives it a real personality.
Really fun game! Definitely worth checking out.
